name: daily
description: Daily-once task runner for Claude Code: a SessionStart hook that runs registered shell tasks ([[task]] in ~/.daily/config.toml) at most once per calendar day and injects a summary of what ran. With no tasks registered it runs a default security audit (cargo deny check). Register/inspect tasks with `daily add` / `daily list`; set enabled=false to disable. Subscription-native (one hook + bundled Rust binary, no API key).
